text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

translations.asad: BEHOLD, from on high have We bestowed this [divine writ] on Night of Destiny.
translations.sahih: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what it is, that Night of Destiny?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

text.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ

translations.asad: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months:
translations.sahih: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

text.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ

translations.asad: in hosts descend in it the angels, bearing divine inspiration by their Sustainer's leave; from all [evil] that may happen
translations.sahih: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

translations.asad: does it make secure, until the rise of dawn.
translations.sahih: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
